intro: The profile already has a strong base: 6 years in analytics, two promotions and dashboards used by a whole sales team. Below, section by section: what to change, where to find it in LinkedIn, and the ready text.

**How to use it.** Copy the texts in blue boxes from the Word file (.docx): PDF viewers add line breaks when copying. [Square brackets] are your data: fill them in or delete the phrase. Keep nothing you could not back up in an interview. While editing, switch off "Notify network" in each form.
